label: Thorned Fairy Island ground
about: A recipe, not game data: neutral ids, our own words, and references into the game (the room archive, its background model and nodes, a room-local volume, the collision group names, the room's distant-view archive). The island is built from the player's own game files into the player's model cache.

memory.measured: game heap with one placement, measured with WWHD_MOD_ACTOR_HEAPS=1 (US game, 2026-10-20); a placement is counted again on top; the distant view is loaded in the neighbouring squares only
